allowance.description: What the agent may call while its turn is open.

context_kinds.description: The kinds of context the turn asks its host to supply, as its step's `context.kinds` (N22): a child run's turn gets only what this and its act declare (D31).

requires.description: What the turn needs from its agent harness, as its step's `requires`. An agent harness that meets one says so in its answer's `requirements`; one that can't ends the turn failed with `unsupported_requirement`.

task.description: The task it performs: a `## Agent task: <name>` section of the package's `SKILL.md`, which carries its instructions.
